primary_whole_readings.draft: Nimm frisches Wurzelmaterial; trockne und zerkleinere es für ein herzustellendes Ergebnis von einer Masseneinheit trockenem Pulver.
Spüle mit Wasser, bis das Material gereinigt ist; danach breite das Pflanzenmaterial dünn und gleichmäßig aus.
Trockne in der Sonne; vermahle grob; trenne mit einem Sieb den groben vom feinen Anteil.
Bewahre den feinen Anteil auf; bewahre den groben Anteil auf. Decke den groben Anteil mit einem Tuch ab; danach lagere diesen Rückstand getrennt.
Nimm das verfügbare Pulver; siebe, bis der gewonnene Pulveranteil fein und gereinigt ist und eine Masseneinheit umfasst.
Wurzelmaterial: zerkleinere es; trockne über Nacht im Schatten; danach durchmische die vorbereitete Gesamtmenge gründlich und gleichmäßig.
Im vorbereiteten Material: zwei Masseneinheiten grobes Mahlgut und eine Masseneinheit Pulver. Trenne diese Teile; hebe den vorhandenen groben Anteil heraus.
Sortiere diesen groben Anteil mit einem Sieb; bewahre eine Masseneinheit Faserstücke und eine Masseneinheit Körnchen auf.
Wasser und Öl sowie eine Masseneinheit des verfügbaren feinen Pulvers: verknete diese Zutaten zu einer Portion Paste.
Vermahle diese Paste mit dem bereits darin enthaltenen Wasser.

schematic_productions.status: A manually offered finite construction inventory, shared by both paragraphs; no claim of a discovered or uniquely parsed grammar.

quantity_diagnostic_rival.decision: This repeated-assertion interpretation conflicts with the NEW common partition contract. It does not refute old P14 M, which did not assert this same partition and ownership graph.
escape_costs: Allow overlapping product descriptions rather than disjoint FIBRES/GRANULES fractions.

node_model.goal: A typed description only; no physical material node.
node_model.mass_rule: Parent and descendants are not simultaneous independent masses. Incorporation preserves component identities but removes their free-stock status.

nominal_compatibility.PLANT_MATERIAL: pure plant stock A/B/C/P/F/G, permitting retained rinse water but not a whole oil/water paste
nominal_compatibility.PREPARED_BULK: the current prepared particulate parent aggregate before it is spent into separate branches, irrespective of whether one or both grade classes are nonzero
nominal_compatibility.COARSE_GRIST: standalone coarse-grist form, not fine powder
nominal_compatibility.COARSE_PART_COARSE_FRACTION: coarse branch of the relevant grade partition
nominal_compatibility.RESIDUE: coarse branch of that grade partition, not any arbitrary later remainder
nominal_compatibility.POWDER: standalone all-fine powder form; whole paste, fibres, granules and coarse grist excluded
nominal_compatibility.FINE_PART: fine branch of the relevant partition
nominal_compatibility.KEEP_COARSE_KEEP_FINE: the corresponding existing branch of the relevant grade partition, also subject to free-stock access
nominal_compatibility.FINE_COARSE_properties: mutually exclusive particle-grade predicates; these are separate from DRY/CLEAN and from the whole carrier kind
nominal_compatibility.WATER: water component under its role-specific access
nominal_compatibility.OIL: oil component under its role-specific access
nominal_compatibility.default: No other compatibility edge. Matching uses class/property/partition records, not literal ledger letters or folio/locus keys. A prepared aggregate may simultaneously satisfy the PREPARED_BULK role and an all-fine/coarse form predicate.

global_effects.CRUSH: Eliminate uncomminuted material into coarse and/or fine sizes without increasing sizes already coarse/fine; preserve desired plant mass and enclosing carrier components. No mandatory positive amount in both size classes.
global_effects.GRIND: Act on the plant-solid constituent, monotonically toward equal or smaller particle size, preserving plant mass, water/oil component identities/amounts and an enclosing paste carrier. For c,p: c_next=c-a,p_next=p+a,0<=a<=c. If c=0, no coarse material is created. Changes within a size bin remain unmeasured.
global_effects.FORM_UPDATE: For a standalone solid, update form class from the resulting distribution: all-fine becomes a powder stock, coarse/fine mixture a prepared bulk. A whole paste remains PASTE while its plant constituent changes. Matching remains subject to free/contained access.
global_effects.DRY: Remove retained carrier water from the active preparation while preserving plant solid and oil; do not identify FINE with DRY.
global_effects.RINSE: Use the written water supply; preserve desired plant solid and particle grade, remove extraneous dirt as required by CLEAN. Retained water is bounded by previous water plus supply; any remainder is drainage, not newly created plant material.
global_effects.MIX: Redistribute current prepared bulk, no new ingredient or mass.
global_effects.SEPARATE_BY_GRADE: Free disjoint coarse and fine branches of the current bulk; positive masses come from the explicit written inventory/named outputs, not universal grinding.
global_effects.LIFT_OUT: Select and move the existing branch, no disposal.
global_effects.SORT: Partition selected input into the two explicitly named disjoint products. Feasibility of the physical sorting discriminator is an unverified condition; no universal common sieve cut is assumed.
global_effects.KEEP_COVER_STORE: Retain/select/cover/store existing material; preserve mass and identity.
global_effects.RETRIEVE: Select existing free compatible material; absence/tie fails.
global_effects.SIEVE: Create designated passing fraction plus disjoint unselected remainder; their combined plant mass equals input. Refining fine input may leave both outputs fine under the previous grade threshold. Zero unnamed remainder creates no node.
global_effects.KNEAD: Incorporate chosen powder and written W/O into one paste aggregate; components are retained but no longer free.
global_effects.WITH_MEDIUM: Use contained water as medium of the active aggregate; no input event.

sieve_limit: Two successive binary separations of a coarse residue cannot both yield positive pass/retain products under one unchanged perfect cut without a relevant material change. V1 did not assert that common cut; V2 likewise leaves tool/discriminator parameters explicit and does not claim physical validation.

Every GRIND necessarily produces positive coarse and powder fractions.
Object disjointness alone is a complete nominal subtype matrix.
retained_conditional_consequences: Local repeated-assertion contradiction, robust to nonnegative loss.
Global2Q versus3Q contradiction only with exhaustive inventory, no fresh plant supply and three disjoint still-live terminal stocks.

ADD and TWO have equal aggregate mass.

execution_status.manual_state_ledger: Every operation/binding and every rival continuation is written explicitly in the linked MD; no computed physical trace is substituted.

record_identity_note: A/B/C/P labels in the manual ledger denote successive or related material records, not hardcoded nominal lookup keys. Updating a form label does not create free material. Consumed parents remain only provenance records.
water_bound_note: On f21r the first DRY leaves zero retained water before RINSE, so the later retained amount satisfies0<=h1<=w; w-h1 is drainage. No water is created by renaming the carrier.

global_frame_and_water_accounting.frame: Preserve ancestry, component amounts and properties except explicitly changed fields. Entry assertions apply at their written step; FRESH need not remain true after processing. DRY, FINE and CLEAN are separate. No unmodeled contamination.
global_frame_and_water_accounting.water_sinks: DRY sends removed water to an external vapor register; RINSE drainage enters a spent-water register. Neither is free ingredient stock. GRIND removes neither water nor oil.
